items.answer: The iterative software development lifecycle for interactive system development comprises feasibility study, requirement gathering, analysis, specification, a design-prototype-evaluate cycle consisting of design, prototyping, and early evaluation, code design, coding and implementation, code testing, empirical study or usability study, deployment and maintenance.

The design-prototype-evaluate loop includes the activities of interface design and interaction design, primarily designing the interface and interaction from the user's point of view based on user requirements, while code design is a separate later design activity.

items.prompt: What is interactive system development lifecycle (ISDLC)?
items.answer: In the interactive system development lifecycle (ISDLC), building interactive software is broadly similar to building regular software, and the differences are in the requirement gathering, design-prototype-evaluate, and empirical study stages.

Extended Reality (XR) is an umbrella term, not a specific technology, that covers all present or future immersive technologies, such as augmented reality (AR), virtual reality (VR), and mixed reality (MR).
Augmented reality on the reality-virtuality continuum is the intermediate state in which the real environment is augmented with virtual content.

Mixed reality, in a broad sense, is the entire space between the real environment extreme and the virtual environment extreme of the reality-virtuality continuum, containing different degrees of augmentation of the real environment with virtual content and of the virtual environment with real content.
